title: Marin Introduces Limited Edition Madrone Trail
content:
Flannel on, jorts ready, bandanna tied. The limited-edition Marin Madrone Trail celebrates 40 years of klunkin’ around on steel…

Marin Madrone Trail Quick Hits

  • 4130 CrMo steel frame
  • Two sizes: medium and large
  • 27.5″ wheels
  • Disc Brakes
  • Cues 10 speed drivetrain with Microshift Cues Thumbshifter
  • Marin Bullmoose Bar
    • 100mm rise
    • 750mm width
  • 27.2 seatpost

Bomb fire roads for the thrill, session until sunset, or roll out to your local watering hole. The limited-edition Madrone Trail reimagines the bike that started it all without sacrificing any modern comforts. The slender 4130 CrMo frame has an unmistakable steel feel – smooth, forgiving, built for foreverness. A one-piece BearMoose bar and stem resurrect the Klunker spirit. Heritage graphics and tan walls finish it. Legends never looked this good.

Find out more at Marin Bikes.
